newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - European ADRs stand out in New York.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - European ADRs stand out in New York.

text.p: European stocks stood out in the American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) market on Monday as Latin American shares treaded water, traders said.
Telefonica de Espana rose 1-1/8 to 61-7/8 on news the Spanish government planned to sell its remaining 21 percent stake in the company in January or February.

The announcement Spain also would sell shares in state companies Repsol S.A. and state bank Corporacion Bancaria de Espana, or Argentaria,, "is clearly significant in showing the government is meeting its privatization goals," a trader said.
Repsol's ADR fell 3/4 to 33-3/4 and Argentaria was off 3/8 to 20-1/2.
Italian energy group ENI SpA rose 3/8 to 47-1/8 after it announced a secondary offering of shares.

Among Latin American stocks, "there is a little bit of firmness but not a lot of activity," one traders said. He said investors were waiting for third-quarter earnings reports and upcoming U.S. economic data.

Telecommunications stocks strengthened, with Brazil's state-owned Telebras up 3/8 to 73-3/4 after falling last week. Telefonica de Argentina was up 1/2 to 23-1/4 and Telecom Argentina rose 5/8 to 37-5/8.
On an index of 441 selected ADRs, advancers led decliners in late-morning trade by a margin of 127 to 108. Volume was 15.7 million shares.
